question_text: A social worker encounters a 15-year-old girl who was recruited by a syndicate to work as a domestic helper in another city under false promises of education. The girl is not paid and is not allowed to leave. Which of the following is the most appropriate legal response under RA 9208 (Anti-Trafficking in Persons Act)?

options.text: File a case for illegal recruitment under the Labor Code.
Report the case to the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) for child protection.
Coordinate with the Philippine National Police (PNP) and file a complaint for trafficking in persons under RA 9208.
Refer the girl to the local government unit for livelihood assistance.
